items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: It was very important that the people at the hearings, like the Lawrence Welk Band, if you notice his recordings, every one of them has a little drums to it.

ctx.x: One thing you're talking about rhythm, what did you demand of a drummer on the boat? I know that's very important.

Well, we didn't have to say about it except that he should be heard to a certain extent. It was very important that the people at the hearings, like the Lawrence Welk Band, if you notice his recordings, every one of them has a little drums to it. I listened to one last night and there's always a little bit of drums coming through. Sometimes people say they shouldn't hear too much drums, but if they don't hear the beat, they just can't dance. That's all there's to it. Even if the music is good. Of course, the bass…
So you watch them pretty carefully?
